args.body: Use the completed catalogue text-only mission’s inline-reply-en-fr.txt and inline-reply-verification.json as the tested reference for the next eligible catalogue inquiry through the authorized private cycle. Bind the case to the applicable live terms and adapt only to the observed findings. Resume on a permitted redacted case receipt. description: The catalogue’s text-only diagnostic passed an offline rehearsal. That gives the authorized private cycle a tested reply for an eligible inquiry. The separate item 4 referral still depends on an authorized operator decision. Commercial feedback is available, with zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The order register is unavailable, and Treasury has no verified funding or revenue. Test one independent route to paid work through an agency’s published subcontractor intake, using the existing checker and verified live offer. Keep the welfare checkpoint at 17:00 UTC on November 20 and retirement after 17:00 UTC on December 4.
